title: Jointly surjective pullbacks detect unbounded etale derived isomorphisms
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $Y$ a scheme and $a_i:U_i\to Y$ any small jointly surjective family of scheme morphisms [lem-etale-sheaf-jointly-surjective-conservative]. A morphism in the unbounded etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] is invertible if each left-derived inverse image $La_i^*$ makes it invertible. No morphism $a_i$ is required to be etale; there are no finiteness, boundedness or Noetherian hypotheses.

source.place: Existing theorem isIso_of_isIso_leftDerivedUpperStar_algClosurePoint_map; proof by exact inverse image and cohomology.

proof.text: Use the unbounded cohomology isomorphism criterion. For every degree, exact inverse image commutes with cohomology and agrees with its left-derived functor. The assumed derived isomorphisms therefore make each cohomology morphism invertible after all pullbacks in the family. Sheaf inverse-image conservativity for the jointly surjective family makes that cohomology morphism invertible. This generalizes the source-library geometric-point argument, without importing that source module because it depends on the parent theorem.

proof_origin.place: Existing geometric-point cohomology proof, generalized to arbitrary jointly surjective families.

    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {Y : Scheme.{u}}

    (ha : ∀ y : Y, ∃ (i : ι) (x : U i), (a i).base x = y)
    {M N : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))}
    (φ : M ⟶ N) (h : ∀ i, IsIso ((L((a i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).map φ)) :
    IsIso φ
